meta.descriptor: a growing city in British Columbia's North Okanagan
meta.fact: home to Kal Tire, Canada's largest independent tire dealer, and forest products maker Tolko Industries

overview: Vernon had 44,519 residents in the 2021 Census, up 11.0 percent from 40,116 in 2016, with 19,776 occupied homes on 96.43 square kilometres. Growth at that pace keeps bringing new households, many of them retirees, into the North Okanagan market.

Employers such as Interior Health, Kal Tire, Tolko and Silver Star Mountain provide a stable base, and seasonal visitors add tourist spending. Local businesses compete for a mix of established families, older residents and visitors.

byService.lead-generation: Vernon grew 11.0 percent from 2016 to 2021, so lead generation should reach newcomers and retirees early, while keeping steady outreach to employees of Interior Health, Kal Tire and Tolko.
byService.seo: Vernon SEO should pair city and neighbourhood terms like Okanagan Landing or East Hill with seasonal searches from Silver Star Mountain visitors looking for food, rentals and services.
byService.website-development: With seniors making up a large share of residents, a Vernon website needs readable type, clear phone numbers and simple booking, while still loading quickly for visitors on mobile.
byService.branding: Vernon branding works when it reflects the North Okanagan lifestyle of lakes, orchards and ski hills, and signals the reliability that long-time residents expect from local firms.
